questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: After didn't use the base form of the verb: didn't go.

wrongReasons.he didn't went to school yesterday: After didn't the verb stays in the base form: go, not went.

questions.wrong: He didn't went to school yesterday.
solutions: He didn't go to school yesterday.
He did not go to school yesterday.

questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: Use the present perfect (simple or continuous) with 'since', not the present continuous.

wrongReasons.i live here since 2010: 'since' + a starting point needs the present perfect (have lived), not the present simple.
wrongReasons.i am living here since 2010: 'since' + a starting point needs the present perfect, not the present continuous.

solutions: I have been living here since 2010.
